mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, event_id, event_version, event_sequence, aggregate_key, event_type, process_instance_id, business_key, task_id, event_digest, event_payload, consume_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_owner, lock_time, error_type, completed_time, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_business_flow_callback_inbox current_event WHERE ( (current_event.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( current_event.consume_status = 'PENDING' OR (current_event.consume_status = 'FAILED' AND current_event.next_retry_time <= #{now}) )) OR (current_event.consume_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (current_event.lock_time IS NULL OR current_event.lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_business_flow_callback_inbox earlier_event WHERE earlier_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND earlier_event.aggregate_key = current_event.aggregate_key AND earlier_event.event_sequence < current_event.event_sequence AND earlier_event.consume_status != 'COMPLETED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_business_flow_callback_inbox active_event WHERE active_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND active_event.aggregate_key = current_event.aggregate_key AND active_event.id != current_event.id AND active_event.consume_status = 'PROCESSING' ) ORDER BY current_event.event_sequence ASC, current_event.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_flow_callback_inbox current_event LEFT JOIN ai_business_flow_callback_inbox earlier_event ON earlier_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND earlier_event.aggregate_key = current_event.aggregate_key AND earlier_event.event_sequence < current_event.event_sequence AND earlier_event.consume_status != 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN ai_business_flow_callback_inbox active_event ON active_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND active_event.aggregate_key = current_event.aggregate_key AND active_event.id != current_event.id AND active_event.consume_status = 'PROCESSING' SET current_event.consume_status = 'PROCESSING', current_event.retry_count = current_event.retry_count + 1, current_event.next_retry_time = NULL, current_event.lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, current_event.lock_time = #{now}, current_event.error_type = NULL, current_event.update_time = #{now} WHERE current_event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_event.id = #{id} AND earlier_event.id IS NULL AND active_event.id IS NULL AND current_event.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( current_event.consume_status = 'PENDING' OR (current_event.consume_status = 'FAILED' AND current_event.next_retry_time <= #{now}) OR (current_event.consume_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (current_event.lock_time IS NULL OR current_event.lock_time <= #{staleBefore})) )
